about.intro: I'm a frontend developer with an eye for detail and a soft spot for clean, well-structured code. I turn designs into fast, responsive interfaces — curious, reliable and always open to learning something new.

projects.title: My work

projects.pokedex: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.responsibleText: This website is a personal portfolio. The person responsible for data processing is Christopher Rauch, Krüthstraße 13, 50733 Köln, Germany. You can reach me by email at krawall-kreativ.de@outlook.de.
privacy.dataText1: When you use the contact form, the name, email address and message you enter are sent to me by email so that I can reply to your request. I only use this data to answer you and do not pass it on to third parties.
privacy.dataText2: When you visit the site, the hosting provider automatically stores technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the time of access in server log files. This is needed to deliver the website securely and reliably.
privacy.legalBasisText: The processing of the contact form is based on Art. 6 (1) (a) and (f) GDPR (your consent and my legitimate interest in answering your request). I keep your message only as long as it is needed to handle your inquiry and delete it afterwards.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict its processing and to object to it. To make use of these rights, simply contact me at krawall-kreativ.de@outlook.de.
